description: Capability bundles (recipes) compose AgentHub packages and tracked third-party extensions for a job. Bundles are install-planning metadata; they are not mega-plugins and do not vendor upstream code.

bundles.title: Technical series production
bundles.summary: Produce a fictionalized technical story series with evidence-bound capture, explanation, and optional Remotion composition.
notes: Series methodology and the technical explainer are media-studio content under skills/studio (formerly skills/video) since 2026-10-21; story-series-studio and technical-storytelling were retired into it.

browser-toolkit was retired at owner direction on 2026-10-30 and is no longer a bundle input; capture lanes now live in each repository's own tooling, and film capture comes from media-studio skills/produce/references/capture.md.
media-studio is the public video pack, including live-product screencasts (Playwright WebM + Recast).

bundles.title: Engaging learning
bundles.summary: Attention-friendly exam coaching with optional visual explainers.
notes: learning-studio was a registered package until its retirement on 2026-10-30, so this recipe requires media-studio directly; visual explainers come from its skills/studio references.
Remotion/animations are optional enhancements, not required to answer a question.

bundles.title: Media production
bundles.summary: Writer/storyboard/director crew for briefings, training, explainers, talking-heads, animation, and audio with remote providers, with Remotion archetype composition for viewer-facing films and Recast pointer finishing for screencasts.
notes: media-studio is the public pack and covers product screencasts plus briefings, training, explainers, talking-heads, animation, and audio. Playwright WebM + Recast live in packages/media-studio.

Remotion is required at runtime for viewer-facing briefing, training, explainer, and series-episode jobs unless intent is draft or the user asked for a basic/proxy cut. Do not vendor Remotion rules; install official remotion-dev/skills.
creative-writing-skills is recommended for viewer-facing narrative (explainers, branded films, series), not for Descript finishing.
Voice clones are for ABACare films, or a job where the owner asks for one (owner direction 2026-11-25); all other films cast expressive, varied stock voices, Deepgram first.

bundles.title: Slack workspace (canonical)
bundles.summary: One AgentHub Slack contract on every coding-agent host. Official Slack skills plugin is optional UX, not authority. Currently requires nothing: the AgentHub Slack capability was retired 2026-10-30.
notes: Checked and absent 2026-11-12: there is no packages/slack, no slack id in registry/capabilities.json, and no slack server in registry/mcps.json. registry/native-connectors.json records that the AgentHub slack bridge was retired with the slack capability on 2026-10-30 at owner direction. This bundle previously required 'slack' and asserted that packages/slack owned the Web API bridge; both were left behind by that retirement.

Correction 2026-11-12: an earlier note here read 'Do not install slackapi/slack-skills-plugin to close a host MCP gap; AgentHub supplies that MCP.' That became false and actively harmful after the retirement, because AgentHub supplies no Slack MCP today and the official plugin is the only available route. Installing slackapi/slack-skills-plugin as optional UX is legitimate.

Forward-looking design is still recorded in docs/plans/active/slack-canonical-capability.md: gateway distribution at 127.0.0.1:8811/mcp plus a remote authenticated endpoint, generationEnabled still false. Reconcile that plan before resuming: its milestone 1 is marked complete although packages/slack was retired afterwards. Test-Bundles.ps1 accepts an unregistered capability when any plan under docs/plans/active mentions the id, so a stale plan satisfies the guard; that gap is recorded in SH-4637.
